title: Open Source Contributor
description: The entry-level track: land merged pull requests and open real issues across tracked Olgax projects.
motto: More PRs. More issues. More impact.

title: Open Source Developer
description: A hands-on shipping track: merge a substantial number of pull requests and review others' work.
motto: Ship more. Review more. Grow faster.

title: Open Source QA Engineer
description: A quality-focused track: run projects locally, file well-documented bug reports/issues, and review pull requests.
motto: Test more. Report more. Break less.

title: Open Source Product Analyst
description: A track spanning the full contribution lifecycle: shipping code, filing well-scoped issues, and reviewing others' pull requests - seeing the whole picture of a project.

title: Open Source Maintainer
description: The highest tier: sustained, long-term involvement across the full contribution lifecycle. Meeting the requirements makes you eligible - a maintainer reviews and approves before the certificate is issued.
motto: Show up. Keep shipping. Own it.
